column1: # DEFAULTS -- docs/design/DEFAULTS.0.md and ADR-011: the short form is
# SUGAR and the long form is the STRUCTURE. `a: *x` means
# `a: *x | super(x)`, and every place the two spellings disagreed is
# resolved in favour of the long form.
# The meet distributes over that disjunction:
# THE FIRST ARM DECIDES. If the preferred value itself still satisfies
# the peer, the default STANDS (narrowed); otherwise the second arm
# answers, and that is the override; and if both are empty, so is the
# --- R1: the first arm -- a peer the default itself admits leaves it
# --- R1: the second arm -- a peer the default cannot admit but its
# --- R1: both arms empty is the emptied disjunction, whatever the
# -- the codes of the gate's own inner meet, naming a meet the author
# --- R2: two defaults of equal rank that cannot agree refuse AS
# defaults, in every spelling. Compatible ones still fold, and
# --- R3: a container default is leafwise in what it ADMITS. The bag
# meets the peer as the bag it is: a map that adds a key MERGES (the
# preferred value itself admits it, so the `p` default survives), and
# a value of another kind refuses. Both used to override outright,
# because a bag had no gate at all.
# --- R4: the gate is super(), so a kind peg and a constraint peg have
# one at last. `super(integer)` is `number`: 7 passes, "s" does not.
# A kind peg gates on the kind's PARENT, so a sibling leaf passes it:
# `super(float)` is `number`, and 1 is a number. Not the widening
# ADR-004 closed, which was about a peg that is a VALUE -- `*8080 &
# --- R5: rank orders the SURVIVORS. Every arm is kept, generation
# takes the lowest rank still standing, and eliminating that arm
# promotes the next -- which used to lose the whole ladder, because
# ranking ran once, before the trials, and discarded the rest.
# Cross-statement layering is a CONJUNCT meet, not a disjunction, and
# is untouched: fewer stars wins, more stars is the weaker layer.
# --- R6: the desugaring is SEMANTIC. Canon keeps the written spelling
# (and so does the aon1- hash), because a parse-time rewrite would
# rehash every document carrying a default.

# --- the dedup that R5 needs: two preferences over ONE value are one

# --- the narrowed override space is DURABLE: it survives the gate
# being recomputed (a rank>=2 default is re-driven every pass) and it
